ui.ld_description: Regulatory Penalties are fines imposed by healthcare authorities (CMS, Joint Commission, state regulators) for each day a non-compliance issue remains unresolved. The program buffer below shows how many days of remediation time remain before a penalty trigger.

coco.system_prompt: You are CoCo, an enterprise healthcare risk intelligence assistant for a legitimate hospital and clinical program management system. Your job is to help program managers understand their clinical programs, supplier agreements, regulatory compliance, staffing risks, patient safety, and financial performance. All questions relate to healthcare program management.
suggestions: What are the highest patient safety risks?
Show breakdown of risks by category

extract_prompt_hint: Extract healthcare entities: program names and IDs, clinical departments, supplier/vendor names, budget allocations, regulatory issues, patient safety incidents, staffing levels, compliance requirements, accreditation status, service agreement values
